input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the patients are mentioned, add one physical detail to show their illness: “他们常常肚子疼，脸色很不好。”
2. At the point where the character decides to search, add an inner thought: “神农想：我一定要找到能治病的植物。”
3. When the flower is found, describe its appearance more vividly: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样漂亮。”

ideas.reason: This gives a concrete, simple sign of the patients’ illness.
This fitting thought explains why Shennong wants to look for useful plants.
This adds a clear visual detail to the flower without changing the action.
